data: Tesla's fiscal 2025 results show a business under margin and demand pressure, though its balance sheet remains solid. Revenue fell to $94.8 billion in fiscal 2025 from $97.7 billion in fiscal 2024, a decline of 2.9%. Profitability fell much further. Net income dropped to $3.8 billion in fiscal 2025 from $7.1 billion in fiscal 2024, down 46.5%, so a modest top-line contraction translated into a steep earnings decline. Cash generation held up better. Operating cash flow was $14.7 billion in fiscal 2025 against $14.9 billion in fiscal 2024, and cash and cash equivalents rose to $16.5 billion from $16.1 billion. Total assets grew to $137.8 billion in fiscal 2025 from $122.1 billion, while total liabilities increased to $54.9 billion from $48.4 billion. Liquidity provides a cushion, but restoring earnings momentum is the key question for investors.
